title: penstemon confertus var. procerus
intro: Penstemon confertus var. procerus, commonly known as Rocky Mountain Penstemon, is a plant species that belongs to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This perennial herb has been used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, offering several health benefits such as soothing digestive issues and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Rocky Mountain Penstemon include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce pain and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
